as_told.title: Edgar Cayce's Hall of Records beneath the Sphinx

plain: This is a story about a hidden library said to lie under the Great Sphinx, the giant stone statue with a lion's body that sits at Giza in Egypt. A researcher named Matt LaCroix, talking to podcast host Jesse Michels, says we are told by Edgar Cayce, a man known for his visions, and by others that an ancient library was meant to be buried beneath the Sphinx. Another researcher, Luke Caverns, tells it on the same show as Cayce's own vision, which he dates to the 1940s. He says Cayce saw a chamber under the Sphinx holding a "hall of records" that tells the story of Atlantis, a legendary lost civilisation. If it were true, the oldest chapter of human history would be sitting in a room under the statue, waiting to be found.
